Description

Nestled right here in the East Bay, this welcoming home brings together classic local character and easy modern comfort. Bright living spaces look out onto mature neighborhood greenery, offering a peaceful retreat just minutes from the waterfront. The kitchen flows right into a sunny dining area, perfect for weekend mornings or casual evenings in. With comfortable bedrooms and a straightforward layout, it is an inviting space to put down roots without any of the usual real estate hassle.

Amenities

  • Sunlit living spaces
  • Updated kitchen & dining area

  • Hardwood floors throughout
  • Wellness center with sauna & cold plunge
  • Plenty of natural light
  • Quiet neighborhood setting
  • Close to local waterfront parks
